performance.verdict: Overdue infrastructure blocks real attribution; CPL gain is real but fragile.

findings.text: 5 overdue SOW milestones (Pre-Launch Stack, LSA Verification, Site Live, Ads Launch, Meta Retargeting) all past July 31–Aug 1 deadlines — no completed events recorded.
Google Ads spend is $0 across the full 45-day series and 28-day window; LSA/Search go-live milestone missed Aug 1 — attribution and volume ceiling both capped.
CPL dropped 32.59% 7d vs prior 7d to ~$89.42 on 28-day basis, driven by Meta Instant Forms; but 5 leads total over 28 days is too thin to confirm efficiency trend.
3-day signal (Sep 5–7): leads held at 1/day while spend swung from $9.72 to $55.44 — CPL volatile ($9.72 to $55.44/lead), not yet a stable trend.
GBP actions dropped 100% 7d vs prior 7d (0 actions vs prior period's positive values); last recorded action was Aug 28 — organic touchpoint dark for 10+ days.

suggestions.text: Clear LSA verification and site-live blockers immediately — Google channel is $0 spend, costing ~$5,000/mo in planned reach.
suggestions.monday_update: LSA verification was due July 31 and site/landing pages were due July 31 — neither shows a completed event as of Sep 8. Google Ads spend remains $0 across all 45 recorded days, forfeiting the ~$5,000/mo Google budget planned in the SOW. Assign owners in Nacer's Ops queue this week. Success = LSA verification submitted and site confirmed live by Sep 12, with a re-check Sep 15.

suggestions.text: Hold Meta budget flat at ~$46.59/day; re-check CPL stability after 3 more days of consistent 1-lead/day volume.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta delivered 4 leads in the last 7 days at a 32.59% improved CPL, but daily spend swung from $9.72 to $55.44 making per-lead cost unstable. Hold daily budget flat and monitor whether the 1-lead/day rate holds at normalized spend. Success check = 3 consecutive days of leads at CPL ≤ $89.42 baseline by Sep 11 re-check.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP dark period — 0 actions for 10+ days; restore profile activity to protect organic intake alongside paid ramp.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 for the period Aug 29–Sep 7 (10 consecutive zero days), versus a prior run rate of 2–9 actions/day. With Google paid ads not yet live, GBP is the only Google-channel touchpoint — its silence removes a meaningful organic lead path. Confirm the GBP profile is active, posting cadence is live, and call-tracking numbers are correctly mapped. Success = GBP actions return above 2/day by Sep 15 re-check.
